column1: # Custom partition table for 8 MB flash.
# `factory` was 0x600000 while the app binary is ~1.2 MB — nearly 5 MB of dead
# space.  The batched-record store needs room for suppressed-event images at
# half the capture resolution (~60-100 KB each)
# could barely hold ten of.  Shrinking `factory` to 2.3 MB still leaves ~2x
# headroom over the current binary and gives the store ~5.6 MB — several days
# of backlog even if WiFi stays down.
# CHANGING THIS REQUIRES `idf.py erase-flash` ONCE: the offsets move
# plain flash would leave the old table in place.  That also wipes NVS

column2: so expect one slower WPA2 handshake afterwards.
